capabilities: Convert a Markdown note into a floor and reply thread
Add, edit, delete, sort, and favorite floors and replies
Switch between Bubble, Glass, Paper, and Timeline layouts
Browse favorite floors from a sidebar and jump to the source record
Resize and describe images in desktop floor view
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later. The native outline adapter targets the internal outline structure in Obsidian 1.13.7 and leaves incompatible structures unchanged. README includes a Simplified Chinese version link, installation via marketplace, BRAT, or manual copy of main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css, plus troubleshooting for marketplace absence, Markdown fallback, failed writes, and stale favorites.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to present a note as a threaded discussion of floors and replies while keeping the content as plain Markdown.
summary: Thread-view plugin that renders a Markdown note as floors and replies with inline editing, favorites, and four layouts.
